BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: The file data leaves the system in an outbound network request.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: The attacker must control the destination or intercept the request.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: No account is needed to receive the request.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: Only data held by the vulnerable application is exposed.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: Local file contents, possibly including secrets, are disclosed.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: Sending the data does not change it.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: The vulnerability class is well documented and proof-of-concept exploits exist.

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: The rule description documents the secure coding fix.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is identified by data-flow analysis from source to sink.
